about.headline: Your technology partner from network cable to custom software.
about.body: SIROTECH Kft. — the leading IT and security technology partner in Székesfehérvár and Fejér County — brings together managed IT and systems administration services, CCTV and alarm installation, bespoke software development, and electrical works under a single legal entity and service contract. No coordination overhead between vendors — one team, one point of contact, full accountability.
